blocks.text: You want to launch a PDF, Canva pack, Notion template, or preset without paying monthly rent before the first UPI sale. Many “free” tiers still take a percentage of every order. This guide compares free-to-start options for Indian creators on what you keep, whether UPI works, and whether you can publish one live product today.
What “free” must mean for Indian sellers

items: You can publish at least one paid digital product without a monthly subscription
Buyers can pay with UPI (GPay, PhonePe, etc.), not only foreign cards
Price shows in ₹ on the product card
Platform fee on the sale is 0% (or the exact published percentage is clear before you list)
The file delivers automatically after payment
One bio URL works for Instagram, YouTube, and WhatsApp

blocks.text: A free plan can still have transaction charges. Work out what is deducted from a ₹499 order and check which fees are platform charges versus payment processing before you put the link in your bio.

blocks.text: Always verify the live pricing pages of each platform. Fees change. Gateway (Razorpay etc.) charges still apply on every successful payment regardless of platform fee.

Check current terms on the official [CloverLoop pricing page](https://cloverloop.in/pricing), [Gumroad fee schedule](https://gumroad.com/help/article/66-gumroads-fees), [Instamojo pricing](https://www.instamojo.com/pricing/) and [Instamojo transaction-fee details](https://instamojo.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/208482245-Instamojo-Transaction-Fees-No-Setup-or-Maintenance-Fees), [Payhip pricing](https://payhip.com/pricing), and [Linktree pricing](https://linktr.ee/s/pricing). Rates, eligibility, currencies and regional payment methods can change.

A platform transaction fee is not always the same as a payment gateway fee. Our [UPI and payment-fees guide](/resources/accept-upi-payments-digital-products-razorpay) explains the distinction; compare those costs with your expected sales using the [earnings calculator](/resources/how-many-sales-to-hit-your-income-goal) and the [digital product pricing guide](/resources/how-to-price-digital-products).
Choose a store only after checking that its payment and delivery setup works for your buyers.

How to assess a low-fee free tier

items: A 0% platform fee can reduce platform charges, subject to product listing limits and other plan terms
Check whether bank payout or payment-provider connection is supported and live
One live paid product is enough to learn what converts
Bio store URL that works across Instagram, YouTube, and WhatsApp
Clear upgrade path only when you need a second live product, email capture, or extra tools

blocks.text: Gateway fees still apply. Do not confuse free hosting with free money movement.
What free usually does not include

items: Unlimited live products
Advanced email capture or automations
Custom domain
Staff logins or advanced branding
Some platforms also limit total free sales or features

blocks.text: Read the current free-plan limits carefully.
24-hour free launch plan

items: Sign up and pick a short username.
Upload one PDF or ZIP (keep size reasonable).
Write a clear 3-line outcome headline.
Set an INR impulse price (often ₹199–₹499 for a first offer).
Connect bank details or payment keys.
Buy your own product once on mobile data and confirm the download.
Paste the store URL in Instagram, YouTube, and WhatsApp.
Post the same CTA for seven days before changing price or adding a second product.

blocks.text: When to leave Free for a paid plan

items: Product #2 is ready and Free only allows one live SKU
You want email capture so one viral Reel can sell product #2 later
You need coupons, deeper analytics, or branding controls
You have consistent sales and the free limits are the actual bottleneck

blocks.text: Do not pay monthly rent before the first UPI proof of concept.
Once you have chosen a free tier that keeps platform fees at zero (or as low as possible) and supports UPI, set up the store and run the first real test purchase.
FAQ: Best free platform to sell digital products in India
What is the best free platform for Indian digital creators?

There is no single best platform for every seller. Compare the plan charge and product listing limits at your expected monthly volume, payment processing separately, and whether your preferred payment methods and delivery needs are supported. CloverLoop Free has a 0% platform fee and a lifetime limit of one paid and five free product listings. Read our [digital product ideas guide](/resources/how-to-sell-templates-online) to choose what to list.
Is Gumroad free for Indian sellers?

You can list without a monthly subscription, but Gumroad charges 10% plus US$0.50 on direct sales, with payment processing additional. That fee structure and its checkout are not UPI-first for most Indian mobile traffic; check [Gumroad's fee schedule](https://gumroad.com/help/article/66-gumroads-fees) before comparing.
Can I sell without a website?
Yes. A bio-link store with UPI is enough for the first products.
Do I need GST to start on a free plan?

A free platform plan does not determine GST registration. It depends on aggregate turnover, the kind and place of supply, and applicable exceptions. Read our [GST registration guide](/resources/do-you-need-gst-registration-to-sell-online) and confirm your circumstances with a qualified tax professional. Payment receipts are not a substitute for tax invoices where those are required.
When should I pay for a higher plan?
When the free limit (usually one live product or a sales cap) actually blocks you and the product is already selling.
Bottom line

The right free starting point is the one that works for your buyers at the volume you expect. Compare platform fees, payment processing, UPI, INR display and working file delivery; do not treat a zero monthly price as zero total cost.
When you are ready to test your own store, begin with one product and verify every step before sharing the link.
